class.name: HEGoTerrain3DInput
class.brief_description: Sends an existing Terrain3D node to an HDA input as heightfield layers.
class.description: Terrain3D stores terrain as independent square regions; Houdini wants one rectangular heightfield. The regions are stitched into a single image, and the control map is unpacked into one weight layer per texture used, plus masks marking which pixels belong to a region at all and which are holes. HEGo finds this handler because it extends [HEGoInputHandler]; HEGo never names it.

method.name: handles
method.description: Whether [param node] is a Terrain3D, and the addon is there to read it.

method.name: sync
method.description: Uploads [param node]'s regions into a heightfield input, reusing [param existing_node] when it already is one. A terrain without regions still yields an empty input, so the HDA input stays connected.

method.name: read_layers
method.description: Reads [param terrain3d_node] into a layer dictionary for [method HEGoHeightfieldInputNode.set_layers], or an empty dictionary on failure. [param input_node_path] is stored on every layer so the HDA can tell which Godot node the heightfield came from.

method.name: get_vertex_spacing
method.description: World size of one terrain vertex. Convenience wrapper so callers only need this class.
